arguments.value: PivX Corporation and Detto Technologies enter into a reseller agreement for Qwik-Fix Pro. PivX gives Detto limited rights to distribute the software and documentation, with exclusive rights in North America and non-exclusive rights elsewhere, but Detto may only resell to third parties who accept PivX’s license terms and Detto may not copy, reverse engineer, or otherwise derive source code from the software. PivX keeps ownership of the software, documentation, trademarks, and all other intellectual property. Detto is responsible for marketing, customer support, compliance with laws, security protections, sales reporting, and making sure its customers accept the required government-restrictions language. Detto must pay per-copy fees, taxes, and other amounts on time, and PivX may audit Detto’s records and restrict sales if Detto defaults. PivX provides limited product warranties and will defend Detto against third-party IP infringement claims, while Detto must indemnify PivX for Detto’s breaches or unauthorized conduct. The agreement lasts six months, may be terminated for convenience or material breach, and on termination Detto must pay what it owes, return or delete PivX materials, and stop using the rights granted, though existing customer licenses remain in place. The agreement also includes confidentiality, liability limits, and other standard legal terms. Governing law: California, with exclusive jurisdiction and venue in the state and federal courts of Orange County, California.
